notes: ChromaVoice v2.0.0 Nectar 4 vocal signal chain overhaul, unified version manifest across all 14 plugins, and automatic Dev folder deployment synchronization.

ChromaCore.notes: ChromaCore v2.7.0: Zero phantom modulation bug fix on wavetable and tone knobs, flat note pitch stability (zero drift when unrouted), 100% click-free factory presets, static GDI+ font caching eliminating GUI dragging lag, and biquad filter stability clamping.
